captions_note: the key words are the caption while the lights are down (KEYWORDS). To let the reel's captions carry the words instead, build with CAPTIONS=0 (lights only) and keep the reel captions on for the slot
in_a_reel: the buyer's style wins: set FONT, the case of KEYWORDS and their colour from the reel's caption style before building (effects/INDEX.md, "Restyling an effect's own words")
set F_IN a few frames after the slot starts and F_OUT before it ends, so the first and last frame are the plain picture. F_OUT = None only when the slot ends on a cut or at the end of the reel
leave GRADE = '' (the reel owns the look)
KEYWORDS are words the speaker says, one to three of them. Look at work/check_edge.jpg at full size before rendering: the cutout edge decides this effect
steps: run onsets.py      # 1. prints word onsets as frames
edit the CLIP block in build.py: F_IN, F_OUT, KEYWORDS
run prep.py      # 2. measures and bakes (1 to 3 min). LOOK at work/check_edge.jpg (full size) and work/check_sheet.jpg
run build.py SAFE=1      # 3. places the words and prints each ink box. It stops if a word is on the face or outside the safe zone
hf snapshot --at 1.0,2.4,2.7,3.4,3.7      # your own times: before F_IN, both words on, mid hold, mid release, after
run build.py      # 4. the clean page (no guide), then render
run check.py      # 5. frame count and plain frames at both ends, writes work/final_sheet.jpg and work/final_edge.jpg
